subject: Key management evidence: engineered handoff plan & sample artifacts
messages:
From: Joanna Meyers <j.meyers@keystitch.io>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@keystitch.io
Date: Sat, 07 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: KMS/HSM evidence for SOC2 + SIG scoping

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for agreeing to help — KeyStitch is working through a SOC 2 readiness check and the auditor asked for a compact evidence set to validate our integration points. Specifically we need evidence that covers: 

- At-rest encryption for tenant data (key hierarchy + KMS used)
- HSM operator shift logs and access separation (sample week)
- Recent key rotation proof for KEK/DEK (timestamps + who initiated)
- Transit encryption and TLS ciphers in use for inter-service traffic

Can you provide a short runbook or handoff checklist and a small sample of logs/artifacts we can share with the auditor? Ideally a one-page runbook + 2–3 sample artifacts (CSV/zip) and any brief notes on our retention windows.

Auditor contact: Daniel Ortiz (d.ortiz@finexaudit.com) — he may follow up with format preferences. We are on a tight window for our readiness gate (deadline: 2027-08-20).

Appreciate it,
Joanna
Senior Security Program Manager
KeyStitch

---
Attachment: request_outline.pdf (stub, 48KB)

From: rachel.kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Joanna Meyers <j.meyers@keystitch.io>, d.ortiz@finexaudit.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 07 Aug 2027 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: KMS/HSM evidence for SOC2 + SIG scoping

Joanna, Daniel —

Thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a compact evidence bundle aligned to SOC 2 / SIG scoping. Proposed deliverables (timeline below):

1) KEK/DEK rotation samples: sanitized CSV with rotation events (who/when/rotation-id) + signed checksum.
2) HSM shift logs: 7-day sample (redacted operator IDs) + accompanying operator separation notes.
3) Runbook: ‘kek-handoff-runbook-v1.md’ — one-page handoff checklist and emergency rewrap steps.
4) Transit ciphers & TLS config export and short narrative on in-transit protections.

Timeline: initial bundle by Tue 2027-08-10 EST; finalized (signed checksums) by Thu 2027-08-12 after internal review.

Questions for you: any PIIs you need preserved in the outputs? We will sanitize tenant IDs and redact user emails unless you ask otherwise. Also confirm if the auditor requires HSM attestation certs (we can include an attestation pointer but full hardware attestation may need a separate request).

I'll route this through Ben for collection of the shift logs and Kimberly for any contract/PO language if we need to surface the artifacts externally.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: planned_deliverables.md (stub, 2KB)

Rachel / Joanna — quick update from my side on artifacts collection: 

- I pulled the rotation history for the KEK namespace (internal id: KEK-N1) and exported a sample CSV (rotations from 2027-05 through 2027-07). File: key_rotation_samples.csv (Sanitized: tenant IDs hashed).
- HSM: shift log archive for July (roles redacted) is packaged as hsm_shiftlog_202707.zip — includes event timestamps, operator shift start/end, and shift ticket references.
- Runbook: drafted kek-handoff-runbook-v1.md (one page) with emergency rewrap steps and DFIR contact.

Nota bene: The HSM attestation cert is available but is maintained by the hardware vendor — we can either include the attestation pointer (vendor portal link) or coordinate a direct upload to your secure intake. Joanna, which do you prefer?

Next steps: I’ll upload the 3 artifacts to the shared Drive folder and post links. Planning to deliver the bundle by EOD today so Rachel can do the internal signatures.

Ben Carter

Thanks team — this looks good. A couple of quick notes before we finalize: 

- Confirm retention policy snippet to include with the bundle (we retain rotation logs and HSM shift logs for 24 months by default; archival copies kept 36 months for regulated customers).
- For SIG: include the mapping of control IDs we’re feeding (I recommend we add a 1-line table mapping our artifacts to SIG questions: e.g., KMS rotation CSV -> SIG.KM-ROT-1). I’ll prepare that mapping and attach to the bundle.
- Joanna: if you need the HSM attestation cert embedded, we'll coordinate a signed upload to your intake portal (we prefer to avoid emailing certs).

Once Ben uploads the artifacts to the Drive link, Rachel — can you append a signed checksum file and a one-paragraph attestation from Redwood legal/security? That will help the auditor accept the sanitized bundle.

Kimberly Park
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
